parsed.note_claim: Iran allowed passage of Chinese vessels through the Strait of Hormuz.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Iran has opened the Strait of Hormuz, a key sea route for oil tankers and container ships, but only for Chinese ships and warned other vessels that any unauthorised crossing will be met with military action.
parsed.reason: The page directly states Iran opened the Strait of Hormuz only for Chinese ships, substantiating the note's claim that Iran allowed passage of Chinese vessels.
